overview: Siblings Sofia, Beto and Ana refuse to experience love and sex like their parents. And that feeling grows stronger when their mother decides to end a 30-year-long marriage. The separation is the event that makes the three of them reevaluate their own emotional choices — and their ability to take care of each other while, at the same time, trying not to stifle their own identities.
title: Lov3

overview: With the European Championship just around the corner, Wesley Sneijder, Dirk Kuyt, Mark van Bommel and John Heitinga look back, but also ahead to the upcoming European Championship.
title: Villa Oranje

overview: Australian influencers flock to Byron Bay for its warm, beachy beauty and cool, creative vibe. Follow these friends as they negotiate life and love.
title: Byron Baes

overview: They're comedians starring in a thrilling drama, but if their jokes don't land in the unscripted scenes, they're off the show. Let the mayhem begin!
title: Last One Standing

overview: After he's shot in 1968, Andy Warhol begins documenting his life and feelings. Those diaries, and this series, reveal the secrets behind his persona.
title: The Andy Warhol Diaries

overview: The former Chicago cop and security guard of "The Jerry Springer Show" gets his own talk show that is adapted from the popular "Steve to the Rescue" shows he did while filling in for Springer. Wilkos says he hopes his show will provide him with a platform to stand up for everyday people and help viewers in need. Common topics include trying to confirm -- often using results of lie-detector tests -- whether guests abused or molested children. Steve also helps guests determine paternity and if guests are cheating on their partners.
title: The Steve Wilkos Show

overview: Phoenix Rising delves behind familiar headlines and explores the often-misunderstood aspects of domestic abuse, helping to shed light on the many factors that prevent survivors from coming forward with their stories as they deal with years of aftershocks and emotional trauma.
title: Phoenix Rising

overview: Arkady is about thirty, and he himself knows that he is a weakling. He was kicked out of work, he lost his home and his beloved girlfriend... It was at this moment that Angela appeared in his life. She seems so carefree, so reckless. Next to her, Arkady can somehow handle everything. There is more between them than falling in love. In a matter of days they become true friends. But it soon becomes clear that angels are not such easy creatures, and their lives can be very difficult...
title: Мой ангел

overview: Lesya and Veronica are sisters on their father's side, and more recently, best friends. Lesya dreams of singing on stage, Veronica helps her sister make her dream come true. But the fashion producer chooses not Lesya, but the liberated Veronica... Suddenly, misfortunes begin to haunt Veronica - people close to her die under mysterious circumstances. The girl herself gets into an accident and miraculously survives. Lesya discovers that she dreamed of all these misfortunes before and then became reality... Is she subconsciously jealous of her sister and going crazy? Or does she have a split personality and is a killer?
title: Не приходи ко мне во сне

overview: Another visit by employees of the regular Moscow district fire department ends tragically. While rescuing a homeless person from a fire, fire crew commander Zakhar Kuznetsov dies. The man rescued from the burnt-out homeless site turns out to be a sailor of the trawl fleet, Denis Ragozin, who came to the capital in search of his runaway wife. Having learned from Captain Mitrokhin, who is investigating the fire, the name of his savior, Denis decides to become a firefighter and go to work in the unit where the deceased Kuznetsov served. However, not everyone likes Ragozin's wishes. Kuznetsov's wife, who got a job as a dispatcher at the fire department after her husband's death, the new crew commander Zubov and some other ordinary firefighters do not want to see Ragozin. But perseverance and dedication help Denis achieve his goal and become one of the best among the capital's firefighters...
title: Огнеборцы

overview: Purposeful and serious entrepreneur Andrei Grekov found himself in a very unpleasant situation and was forced to pay a large sum of money. However, now is not the best time in the hero's life, his property has been confiscated, and he doesn't have a penny in his pocket. The only valuables the young man has left are an old tanker, thanks to which he receives a strange order for the transportation of oil. The hero doesn't think long about the suspicious matter, because the money needs to be given back very urgently. A seemingly simple task turned out to be not so easy, and now Andrei found himself in the midst of dangerous and serious events.
title: Танкер «Танго»

overview: The Bill Cunningham Show, Tribune Broadcasting's nationally syndicated daytime talk show launched in 2011, and has made a difference in the lives of viewers, helping to resolve conflicts and mend relationships, while making viewers laugh and giving them hope. The Bill Cunningham Show's guests come to us to get to the bottom of an issue, find out the truth, reveal a secret, reunite with a family member or confront a relationship issue head on. The show also has a fun side. With Bill's witty commentary and "Billisms," his audience is getting to know his humor by chanting his catch phrase, "let's put the cheese on the cracker."
title: The Bill Cunningham Show

overview: Our whole life is a battle against stereotypes. When are you getting married? When you become a mum? When to have a second? 45 years old - is it too late? Overcoming, disappointment, tears, laughter, joy and happiness - the whole spectrum of human emotions will be seen by the viewers of the channel "Yu" in a new reality show about women who decided to become mothers after 45.
title: Беременна в 45

overview: Set during the Ming dynasty during the rule of Yongle Emperor, it tells the story of a young girl named Yao Zijin, who entered the palace to become a maid of the food bureau. In the deep palace, she remains determined and slowly work her way up while perfecting her craft; while friendship and romance at the same time. Through her romantic entanglement with Zhu Zhanji, the drama also showcases the historical achievements and family life of three outstanding emperors of the Ming Dynasty, portraying a gourmet Forbidden City full of rich family affection, friendship, love and humanity.
title: Royal Feast

overview: Talkshow with Wilfred, Johan and Rene about the news of today.
title: Vandaag Inside

overview: To save a beloved girl who needs expensive treatment, the artist kidnaps nine young female fans of a popular music group. He gets in touch with their relatives and demands a ransom. However, when the money is collected, the kidnapper disappears without a trace. This is how a dangerous game begins, where power passes from the hands of the executioners into the hands of their victims.
title: Власть

overview: Four kids at Silverpoint Adventure Camp stumble upon something strange buried out in the woods, which sends their lives and the world around them spiralling out of control.
title: Silverpoint

overview: Auriane used strong chemicals to change herself. Today she has a dream of going with great afro, but why is this so difficult and scary?
title: Krøll

overview: "Alyssa" is a story about the fragility of growing up, the fear of loneliness and the importance of motherly love and support. Alyssa is only fifteen, and her teachers are tired of calling her mother into school, while Alyssa's mother can't understand what is going on with her child. Alyssa then finally learns what has been hidden from her for years: she will soon go completely blind. A little longer, and she will be in total darkness. She vows to live to the fullest while she can and decides that it would be stupid to waste time on school. It is better to grow up fast, earn some easy money, and move to a big and beautiful city. But pretty soon Alyssa's teenage illusions are shattered by reality, and her mother's strategy of pretending that all is well will inevitably lead to disaster.
title: Алиса не может ждать

overview: The Oprah Winfrey Show has featured many celebrities over the years, but that's only one side of it. There's also Oprah's eternal quest to better herself, and to make the viewers change themselves. Oprah has started several organizations: Oprah's angel network, Oprah's book club, and O Magazine. For a couple of years now, the show frequently ends with a "Remember your spirit" segment. The show is produced by Oprah's own company, Harpo (which spells Oprah backwards). The Oprah Winfrey Show is now entering its 17th year of production as a syndicated show.
title: The Oprah Winfrey Show

overview: A cyclone is a meteorological phenomenon that occurs when you have to manage 3 children, a self-employed job, an ex-boyfriend and his new too-young girlfriend, daycare schedules, meals, school, lunches, the new employee - And in the eye of this Cyclone is Isabelle, 39 years old, a single mother who has the mental burden of all this in addition to having to put up with a sister who is better than she is at everything, a mother who reminds her that her sister is better than she is at everything, and a barren love life.
title: L'Oeil Du Cyclone

overview: It tells the story of three siblings who want to escape their stifling lives and a mysterious outsider who comes to their town.
title: My Liberation Diary

overview: The show tells about cult personalities studying at the Murom Institute.
title: Ларинские блудни

overview: What will happen if, as a result of biological warfare, almost the entire male population dies out? Women will get excited (not for long), and then they will unite and create a new better world — with eco-towns, renewable energy, opportunities to do whatever they want, even science and biohacking, even yoga and self-development. Reproduction now takes place by artificial insemination, and only girls are born in the new world. But not everyone likes such a world order. Some of the surviving men and women loyal to them go to live in abandoned megacities, start stealing electricity, enjoying freedom and traditional sex. The tranquility of the perfectly arranged female world is under threat when the teacher Rada from the eco-city "Two Hills" meets a young "primate" Hera outside of it.
title: Два Холма

overview: The story takes place in 1917. Véronique is a young woman of 35 years, nurse at the military hospital of Besançon. She suddenly learns of the murder of her husband, the mysterious Count Vorski, whom she has not seen for fourteen years. Her research will also lead her to the track of her father and son whom she believed to have died in a shipwreck, already a long time ago. From clue to clue, here we are in Brittany, on this island with a name so ill-fitting... Brutal deaths, enigmatic words written... by whom? A frightening prophecy, the superstitious terror of the island's inhabitants, and suddenly, Veronica d'Hergemont can no longer leave this island. She's stuck alone. Almost alone...
title: L'Île aux 30 cercueils

overview: In the company of his fellow comedians, Stéphane Bern gives the "promotional artist" all the raw material to succeed in this exercise in other shows, with one objective: to be funny.
title: Code Promo

overview: Depicts the connection between people in a new era through the work, way of life, and romance of the people who work there, with the editorial staff of the news site as the main character. Kanfuru News is an online news media website, run by a large publishing company. Their articles are written by the editorial team, who are all men, and consists mostly of rearranged stories and comments from other websites. Their goal is to only increase page views. One day, Seko Ririko is transferred to the editorial team from the accounting department.
title: Gossip: #Kanojo ga Shiritai Honto no ○○

overview: The series follows "Bee Czar" Walter Schumacher and his mission to save the planet through saving honeybees, all without wearing a protective suit — instead, he "communicates" with bees to avoid being stung. Schumacher works with his team at the American Honey Bee Protection Agency to rescue hives from places they're unwanted, like the walls of a house or up a neighborhood tree, and relocate them to sites where they can thrive in peace. Bee Czar will show Schumacher's efforts to rebuild his business from the ground up after losing everything in the COVID-19 pandemic, transforming his family farm into a new headquarters for his work, and training rookie bee wranglers. The series will also feature his oldest son Will, who works to land contracts selling honey to businesses such as restaurants and distilleries.
title: Bee Czar

overview: A winged fighter that hasn't lost a fight in 26 years, a lifesaver that's part plane and part chopper, and an attack helicopter our enemies call the Black Death. These are America's undisputed kings of the sky: the F-15 Eagle, the V-22 Osprey, and the AH-64 Apache. And their success stories are as remarkable as they are improbable. Witness their turbulent journeys, brought to life through rarely seen combat footage and the stories of the dedicated pilots and teams who fly and maintain these ultimate Air Warriors.
title: Air Warriors

overview: "The Morton Downey Jr. Show" was one of the early shock-talk shows, Downey was a precursor to later hosts such as Jenny Jones, Ricki Lake and Jerry Springer. Downey's show tended to focus on political, rather than personal issues, but guests were still chosen on the basis of their dislike for one another, and their tendencies to lose their tempers suddenly, loudly and violently. These outbursts were encouraged by 'moderator' Downey, who would continually goad his guests to their limits.
title: The Morton Downey Jr. Show

overview: Pax Assadi is your typical 12-year-old from the early 2000s. His parents came to NZ in the late '80s as refugees and want him to get good grades, but all Pax wants to do is fit in. However, a major international incident makes that very difficult.
title: Raised by Refugees

overview: A journalist working in the same newspaper as her husband, and intellectual conflict arises between them because of the differences between the nature of men and women. The series shows the relationship between the spouses, revealing many attitudes of the "Eastern Man".
title: Diary of a Very Angry Wife

overview: Nour Abdel Mejid, AKA Valentino, owns a number of international schools, "Valentino Schools", run by him and his domineering wife with whom he's not in agreement. Their disagreements, however, get them on several adventures and reveals many surprises along the way.
title: Valentino

overview: Food Network star, acclaimed chef, and restaurateur Geoffrey Zakarian is looking to invest $250,000 of his resources for the next rising star in the restaurant world. Geoffrey presents eight talented chefs with the opportunity to take the next step in their culinary career with challenges to determine who has what it takes to run their first restaurant. When it comes to developing and operating a successful restaurant, there is no one with more knowledge than Geoffrey, and he is putting his reputation on the line to lift up a new generation of chefs competing to make their restaurant vision come true. Throughout the competition the aspiring restaurateurs must prove they can develop a restaurant and make it profitable from the ground up in real world challenges that put their culinary and business expertise to the test, including the creation of a full menu for their proposed restaurant in a grand tasting to impress Geoffrey and his advisors. In another episode, the chefs tackle the challenges associated with running a restaurant's front of house as they each take turns helping the guests. But what the chefs don't know is Geoffrey has filled the restaurant with actors meant to cause havoc and see how the competitors react on their worst day. The two chefs who advance to the finale take on the hardest test of their life, operating their dream culinary concept in a restaurant takeover, complete with overseeing staffing and cooking for real diners. Which chef will Geoffrey decide to invest his time and energy into and make their dreams come true?
title: Big Restaurant Bet

overview: An omnibus-style drama that tells the sweet, sour, and bitter life stories of diverse characters in the setting of Jeju Island.
title: Our Blues

overview: Private detective Martin Kane works in New York solving crimes. Depending on the year, Kane was either smooth and suave or hard bitten and the cooperation he received from the police depended on the year. The only constant was Happy McMann's tobacco shop where Kane hung out.
title: Martin Kane, Private Eye

overview: Inspired by the true-life story, on December 21, 1988, 259 passengers and crew were killed when Pan Am Flight 103 exploded over Lockerbie 38 minutes after take-off, with a further 11 residents losing their life as the plane came down over the quiet, Scottish town. In the wake of the disaster and his daughter's death, Dr Jim Swire, is nominated spokesperson for the UK victims' families, who have united to demand truth and justice. Traveling across continents and political divides, Jim embarks on a relentless journey that not only jeopardizes his stability, family and life, but completely overturns his trust in the justice system. As the truth shifts under Jim's feet, his view of the world is left forever changed. Exploring events from the disaster and its aftermath, Lockerbie: A Search for Truth provides an intimate account of a man, a husband, and a father who risks everything in memory of his daughter and the unflinching pursuit of truth and justice.
title: Lockerbie: A Search for Truth

overview: Would you let a convicted criminal stay in your home? Presented by Danielle Cormack, this ground-breaking new series follows a unique initiative to tackle recidivism - a person's relapse into criminal behavior. Follow four Australian households that are prepared to offer their spare room to a formerly incarcerated person for 100 days.
title: Life on the Outside

overview: ZERV tells of the first years after the fall of the Wall, the breaks in life courses, of completely different biographies and of the successful encounter in the common fight against crime, which knows neither East nor West. ZERV stands for "Zentrale Ermittlungsstelle für Regierungs- und Vereinigungskriminalität", the Central Investigation Agency for Government and Association Crime, which was founded in Berlin in 1991 by decision of the federal government. Karo Schubert fought for a position as chief inspector in reunified Germany. When she investigates the murder of a high-ranking employee of the Ministry of Disarmament, she meets Peter Simon, the newly appointed Western Commissioner from the special unit ZERV for the first time. They are forced to investigate together - because both claim the murder case for their department. But the various tasks of the ZERV can only be solved for Peter Simon and his team in cooperation with the Eastern colleagues.
title: ZERV - Zeit der Abrechnung

overview: The Ricki Lake Show is an American first-run syndicated talk show hosted by Ricki Lake. The series also marked her return to talk television after leaving the genre in 2004. After several years of considering coming back to daytime with a new talk show, Lake signed on as both host and producer with 20th Television for this project, which debuted in United States and Canada on September 10, 2012, and began taping episodes on July 25, 2012, at the Culver Studios.
title: The Ricki Lake Show

overview: Matar al padre shows the story of Jacobo Vidal, an authoritarian lawyer in his work and in his family who wants to have control of all areas of his life and those around him, especially his children Valeria and Tomás. At the time of post-Olympic Barcelona, he will have no qualms about overcoming all obstacles that may arise so that the well-being of his family fits in with his vision of life. But fifteen years later, in the economic crisis, Jacobo will realize that his life is not as planned: his wife has thrown him out of the house, his son has given himself to alternative therapies, his daughter wants to live away from him and above it he is ruined and homeless. For all this, he begins to question his way of seeing life.
title: Matar al padre

overview: Force and Book, who've known each other for over fifteen years, take viewers on casual day trips within Thailand.
title: Force Book Show Real

overview: Sakaino Hitomi is an honest lady from a well-to-do family. She is envied by everyone for being engaged with Akashi Keigo, a man with a good appearance, high income, high education, and kindness. Hitomi is about to get married but suddenly becomes attracted to a man, Manabu, who she met at a construction site.
title: Bewitched by My Sexy Boyfriend

overview: The Egyptian version of the famous American show Suits. Follow the story of Adam Mansour (Mike Ross) played by Ahmed Dawood and Zain Thabet (Harvey Specter) played by Asser Yassin.
title: Suits

overview: After twenty years of traveling the world to take care of wild animals, Victor decided to get closer to his children aged 10 and 15. This is why he accepted the proposal of his childhood friend, Laurent, to take over the management of the Paraclete animal reserve. Victor still finds himself very sensitive to the charm of his wife, Mathilde, whom he has never stopped loving. For her part, if she had really turned the page, she would have asked for a divorce, right? Unless she has found comfort and tranquility with this "brave Henri", the good friend of always... Baptiste and Zoé rediscover a full-time father, and Victor must now assume shared custody of his children. A mission at least as demanding as his job as a veterinarian, and for which he is not quite prepared. Twenty years in the bush makes you forget the refueling at the supermarket and the traffic jams! But Victor chose this "reconversion" because he no longer wanted to live away from his children. Basically, he just changed jungle...
title: Victor Sauvage

overview: Budget cuts won't stop these incompetent deputy sheriffs from trying to uphold the law.
title: Reno 911! Defunded

overview: Brings in front of the viewers a cooking show with top ingredients: 3 famous chefs - chef Sorin Bontea, chef Florin Dumitrescu and chef Cătălin Scărlătescu, spectacular places, traditional recipes, carefully crafted missions, competition and suspense.
title: Chefi fara limite

overview: Have you ever seen Péter Hajdú in his pajamas? Now it turns out what it's like when your friends and acquaintances jump up to him for a little casual togetherness. One day closed with Péter Hajdú. There is privacy in it!
title: Összezárva Hajdú Péterrel

overview: Ricki Lake is a daytime tabloid talk show hosted by American actress Ricki Lake. The series debuted in syndication on September 13, 1993 and ended first-run episodes on May 21, 2004, though the series continued in reruns through the summer until August 27, 2004. The show specialized in sensationalist topics involving invited guests and incorporated questions and comments from a studio audience. But unlike most of the counterparts of the day, her primary audience was aimed at teenagers, young adults, college students, and urban viewers (who described themselves as "Generation X") rather than the 25+ audience that advertisers were catering to, plus it was less sensational and tame compared to the other programs. It was taped at the Chelsea Studios in New York City.
title: Ricki Lake

overview: The psychologist Paul, who specializes in animal-assisted therapies, and the Australian Shepherd bitch Käthe take on demanding cases. The tandem helps people get back on their feet after accidents and illnesses.
title: Käthe und ich

overview: The Range Rider was a youth friendly television western created by Gene Autry's company Flying A Productions in the early 1950s. The show starred professional stuntmen Jock Mahoney as the Range Rider and his sidekick Dick West played by young actor Dick Jones.
title: The Range Rider

overview: Death on the Beach examines the tragic roll call of numerous young travellers who have died under mysterious circumstances on the popular, remote backpacking Thai island, Koh Tao.
title: Death on the Beach

overview: See your body like never before - from the inside out. Kate Garraway and Dr Guddi Singh use the latest technology to help patients understand their everyday medical conditions.
title: Your Body Uncovered with Kate Garraway

overview: Eponymous adaptation of Armenian writer Nar-Dos's 1889 novella "The Killed Dove" about a tragic love story.
title: Սպանված աղավնի

overview: The media reports on the rapid spread of a virus that transforms humans into wild beasts. Given this, Anna seeks to escape and get away from her family, but on the way, chaos takes over the situation and Anna will try to survive the infected who are dangerous in order to reunite with her family, however, on this journey she will be put in I play the line between life and death.
title: Viral

overview: Joe Millionaire is an American reality dating show that premiered on Fox in 2003. The first two seasons of the series followed a group of single women, competing for the affection of a bachelor who was falsely billed as being a millionaire. If the last remaining woman still accepted the love of the bachelor despite the ruse, the couple would also win a high-value prize. The first season of Joe Millionaire premiered on January 6, 2003. The series was highly successful, with Fox promoting that its season finale (seen by an average of 34.6 million viewers) was the highest-rated entertainment program (excluding Super Bowl lead-out programs) aired on network television since 2000.
title: Joe Millionaire

overview: The series revolves around four couples, and one set of roommates, of varying ages and backgrounds. With a realistic tone, the dramatic comedy explores in a raw and unexpected way the drama and hilarity experienced by couples in the intimacy of the bedroom.
title: Pillow Talk

overview: Crime stories that Walter Winchell had covered while working with the New York City Police Department.
title: The Walter Winchell File

overview: "The Queen Latifah Show" is the title of two American television talk show programs hosted by the actress, singer and entertainer Queen Latifah. The original The Queen Latifah Show ran from September 13, 1999 to August 31, 2001. The revamped The Queen Latifah Show debuted September 16, 2013, and was renewed for a second season in January 2014. On November 21, 2014, Sony Pictures Television cancelled The Queen Latifah Show after two seasons due to low ratings. Production ceased on December 18, 2014 and the final episode aired on March 6, 2015, with reruns to continue airing until the end of the television season.
title: The Queen Latifah Show

overview: Christine shares a happy life with her husband Raphaël until the day she receives a mysterious video: images of her childbirth fifteen years earlier, on the island of Sarek, where her son was stillborn. Now haunted by the possibility that her son is alive, she returns to this island to investigate. Based on the novel by Maurice Leblanc.
title: L'Île aux trente cercueils

overview: Andy and the Band risk missing their next gig by taking on super-weird odd jobs for their fans. A madcap mix of songs, slapstick and silliness.
title: Andy and the Band

overview: What do Jeff Bezos, Jamie Foxx and the most baller orthodontist in Beverly Hills have in common? They're all DM'ing celebrity car dealer RD Whittington. This is a behind-the-scenes look at how he connects the ultra-rich with their million-dollar toys.
title: Million Dollar Wheels

overview: Marcus Wareing steps back from his hectic schedule to spend more time expanding his smallholding in East Sussex with the help from the country's very best British producers.
title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden

overview: From Derbyshire to the Scottish Borders, we explore the magnificent upland range of the Pennines and meet the people who call its mountains, fells, hills and valleys their home.
title: The Pennines: Backbone of Britain

overview: The Flatshare follows Tiffany and Leon, two cash-strapped London twentysomethings who share a bed. The catch is – Tiffany and Leon have never met and, if their plan works out, they never will.
title: The Flatshare

overview: Four detectives. Four timelines. One body. To save Britain's future, they'll need to solve the murder that altered the course of history first. Stephen Graham stars in this time-hopping crime drama inspired by Si Spencer's graphic novel.
title: Bodies

overview: Eve Garance is a remarkable sketch artist capable of "reading" people. In the Investigation Unit of the Police Department, she uses her talents to create composite sketches to catch criminals. Her colleagues include Maryse Ferron, the methodical director whose disability has never stopped her; Bernard Dupin, the seasoned investigator who keeps the dark regions of his life under wraps, and Anthony Kamal, the new technician who doesn't know what he is getting into. This is the team assigned to solve a laundry list of sordid crimes. They will tackle also cold cases - even if old wounds are opened in the process. The return of Eve's ex will force her to reopen a very personal cold case: that of the disappearance of their son William, then six months old. For five years, Eve has been secretly imagining and sketching the faces that her son could have today in the hope of finding him one day.
title: Portrait Robot

overview: "The Tyra Banks Show", also known as and shortened to Tyra or The Tyra Show, is an American talk show hosted by Tyra Banks. While Banks's show covered a variety of topics, there was a sensationalized focus on current issues facing women, with often special episodes on America's Next Top Model, which Banks herself had also created and which she still hosts. In its later seasons, it took on a tabloid format similar to shows such as Maury and The Montel Williams Show, covering topics such as people with odd psychological problems, among other subjects. The show was aired in many countries, and also remained available on XM Satellite Radio's Take Five channel in both the United States and Canada.
title: The Tyra Banks Show

overview: The place is Oslo, the year is 2002, and Roger Brown is a newly employed headhunter in an exclusive recruitment agency. He is given the prestigious task of finding a new top manager for the oil company Njord Oil. Roger is willing to do whatever it takes to quickly climb the career ladder.
title: Hodejegerne – Den første løgnen

overview: Becoming parents has not broken the ties that unite Nadine, Kamyar, Annie, Philippe and Josée. On the contrary, it is the humor and the frankness that allows this long-standing friendship that allows them to - survive their children.
title: Survivre à ses enfants

overview: Money made America a global empire, and for the last century America's riches have been controlled by the titans of Wall Street. J.P. Morgan; Teddy Roosevelt: Henry Goldman & Samuel Sachs; Joe Kennedy; Charles Merrill & Edmund Lynch; Franklin Roosevelt; Ivan Boesky; Michael Milken. Before their names were institutions, they made fortunes, created entire industries and shaped global events. This documentary series exploits world's fascination with Wall Street by fully exploring its stories — its banks, its firms, its CEOs, even its criminals — and, more importantly, how Wall Street works. Each instalment is brought to life with powerful drama, archival footage and gripping sit-downs with the most influential CEOs, investors and traders living today to provide the definitive account of the power, opulence and perilous missteps of American finance.
title: Titans: The Rise of Wall Street

overview: Twisted Metal is about a motor-mouthed outsider offered a chance at a better life, but only if he can successfully deliver a mysterious package across a post-apocalyptic wasteland. With the help of a trigger-happy car thief, he faces savage marauders driving vehicles of destruction and other dangers of the open road, including a deranged clown who drives an all too familiar ice cream truck.
title: Twisted Metal

overview: Something Bit Me! explores the true stories of animal and insect attacks as well as bites and stings that have resulted in sending people to the E.R.
title: Something Bit Me!

overview: The Rogues follows the adventures of the Fleming-St. Clairs, an upper class family of con artists who always do the right in the end.
title: The Rogues

overview: South America's Weirdest Animals dives into the depths of the South American wild to investigate the cast of misfits, the oddities, the weird, the eccentric and the truly bizarre. The landscape here is truly one of a kind. So, the animals have evolved accordingly. In the South American wild, strange problems gave rise to even stranger solutions.
title: South Americas Weirdest Animals

overview: Faten's decision to get a divorce soon drags her into a struggle to change a law that may deprive her of her rights and children if she remarries.
title: Faten Amal Harby

overview: Two restless labourers find themselves facing larger-than-life challenges amid falling in love and rising from lower rungs.
title: El Meshwar

overview: Brought together by fate, three insomniac middle-aged women go on a journey that helps them overcome their personal challenges and lead more satisfying lives.
title: Ahlam Saeida

overview: In a private school, a new unqualified social counselor is hired by mistake because of names similarity only.
title: Dayman Amer

overview: Series that goes behind the castle gates and palace walls to reveal the little-known facts and fascinating secrets of Britain's spectacular royal gardens and parks.
title: Secrets of the Royal Gardens

overview: Thirty young street dancers from Bristol aim for gold at the world championship hip hop dance competition as they prepare for the challenge of their lives.
title: Street Dance: Against the Odds

overview: Amol Rajan, the BBC's media editor, interviews the global, era-defining pioneers, leaders and maverick thinkers who are shaping our rapidly changing 21st-century world.
title: Amol Rajan Interviews

overview: A reality show about people from different generations who have decided to be together. Every day they face misunderstanding and condemnation. How to cope with all the difficulties and keep the love?
title: Статус: неравный брак

overview: This pan-Arab anthology series tinged with dark humor explores love at large — and relationships up close.
title: Love, Life & Everything in Between

overview: Undercurrent: The Disappearance of Kim Wall tells the story of accomplished journalist Kim Wall, who tragically went missing in 2017. She was last seen just prior to interviewing the eccentric entrepreneur Peter Madsen aboard his self-made submarine in Danish waters. Madsen changes his story multiple times during the course of a police investigation that ultimately uncovers the truth: Wall was murdered on the submarine. Madsen is soon put on trial, and a judge is tasked with determining what actually happened on the vessel.
